seo.title: About Us — Lithium Fire Killer Extinguisher Distributor | FAST
seo.description: Get to know PT. Famindo Alfa Spektrum Teknologi (FAST), the exclusive distributor of the Lithium Fire Killer Hartindo AF31 extinguisher in Indonesia.

intro.heading: About Us
paragraphs: PT. Famindo Alfa Spektrum Teknologi (FAST) is a company focused on providing security solutions against fire risks. FAST is the exclusive distributor of the Lithium Fire Killer Hartindo AF31, the world's first fire extinguisher proven effective in extinguishing lithium-ion battery fires with an eco-friendly formula safe for humans and the environment.

In addition to presenting superior products, FAST is also committed to educating the public about fire hazards, especially lithium-ion battery fires, and providing an understanding of how to handle them safely and effectively.
highlights: The World's #1 First Lithium Extinguisher Distributor
Trusted by Government Agencies & Major Business Sectors
intro.quote: The world's first fire extinguisher proven effective in extinguishing lithium-ion battery fires with an eco-friendly formula.

history.headline: Started From a Calling to Help Many People

blocks.subheading: With a Solid Team, Everything is Achievable
paragraphs: This story began with Randall Hartolaksono, the inventor of Lithium Fire Killer Hartindo AF31, with a vision to save many lives from the risk of lithium battery fires in Indonesia. This spirit was then continued through PT. FAST, founded by Willy Hadiwijaya, as the pioneer and exclusive distributor of the world's first lithium fire extinguisher.

blocks.subheading: Started From a Calling to Help Many People
paragraphs: PT. FAST is committed to continuously innovating and developing the latest products that can help the community face fire hazards. Through various programs, FAST is committed to increasing public awareness to prioritize life protection and be trained in facing potential fire hazards that come unexpectedly.

blocks.subheading: Continuously Innovating While Educating the Public
paragraphs: PT. FAST does not only act as a provider of fire safety products but is also dedicated to educating and socializing the importance of safety. Through various programs, FAST is committed to increasing public awareness to prioritize life protection and be trained in facing potential fire hazards that come unexpectedly.
